tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be an NABL accredited certified consultant who has successfully carried out Water Audit / Independent technical & commercial consultancy services in any projects of Thermal Power Plants in India and shall be a legally registered consulting / advisory firm in India & accredited by NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories). As a proof the agency shall furnish copy of Company Registration Certificate & NABL Accreditation Certificate.b. The bidder shall have completed water audit at any of the 200 MW and above capacity Coal Fired Thermal Power Plants in India. The agency shall furnish the following: The Copy of Work Order costing not less than Rs.14 Lakhs in any one financial year during the last five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Satisfactory Completion Certificates signed by competent authority / CEO of respective projects certifying the satisfactory performance of the firm for any one year during the last five financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have an average annual turnover of Rs.54/- Lakhs in any two years during the last five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). As a proof the intending bidder shall furnish the turn over certificate and balance sheet duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents shall be furnished.
Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
